location_address: 6353 Cascade Rd Joshua Tree, CA US 92252
description: Join us at Cascade Trails for a one-of-a-kind event blending hands-on equine interaction with a taste of California’s finest wines! Start the experience by connecting with our horses during an interactive session that offers insight into their care, behavior, and unique stories. Once you’ve immersed yourself in the equine world, enjoy a thoughtfully curated tasting from Wiley Wines. Known for their minimal-intervention approach, Wiley Wines crafts single-varietal wines from organically farmed, Northern California vineyards. Each pour celebrates the rugged beauty of California’s landscapes and the pure, unfiltered essence of each grape variety, inspired by founder Phineas Fittipaldi’s passion for wine, nature, and desert charm. This is a perfect pairing for wine and animal lovers seeking an authentic and enriching experience.
what_is_included:
Interactive Equine Experience
	•	Hands-on session with horses.
	•	Insights into horse behavior and care practices at Cascade Trails.
	•	Personalized guidance from knowledgeable staff for a safe and memorable interaction.

Curated Wine Tasting by Wiley Wines
	•	Guided tasting of 3-4 wines, led by Phineas Fittipaldi or a Wiley Wines representative.
	•	Discussion on the minimal-intervention winemaking approach and vineyard stories.
	•	Enjoyment of unique, single-varietal wines from organically farmed Northern California vineyards.


Access to Beautiful Cascade Trails Ranch
	•	Time for photos, mingling, and taking in the desert landscape and natural beauty.
	•	The chance to purchase wine or small keepsakes as mementos of the day.
what_is_not_included:
•	Transportation

	•	Carrots for the horses or grapes for the goats. Available for purchase at the ranch.
